physical_explanation: For ideal fixed payout, g(q)=ell(q)-L<=0, lambda>=0 and lambda*g=0. Slack tendons transmit no compressive reaction. Equilibrium uses grad(U)+Jell.T*lambda-JF.T*F=0 under declared sign conventions.

physical_explanation: Virtual work maps tension through the route-length Jacobian. Chord shortening, guide placement and actual solid plates alter length changes during finite bending.

A local row-space match describes infinitesimal kinematics. Finite-load response also requires feasible tension signs, excitation, deformed routes and valid dynamics. Abstract route points are not installed guides.

general-equilibrium.summary: Equilibrium, KKT regularity and stability are separate qualifications.

On a fixed regular taut set, [Kt,JA.T;JA,0][dq;dlambda]=[JF.T*dF;0]. Kt includes material, geometric and load stiffness. Switching or degeneracy requires branch-aware treatment.

Added guides, gaps and section changes can alter stiffness, mass and modes together. Viscosity changes transient dissipation within the declared constitutive model. Gravity and inertial effects must be distinguished from elasticity.
